Package edu.secourse.patientportal.controllers

Class AppController

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.controllers.AppController
public class AppController extends Object
High-level controller for creating patients, doctors, and appointments. Uses the service layer rather than doing any storage itself.
